core_obligations: Section case: F cap f_*G is contained in the image of sigma^*G -> F, coherent by the Serre characterization (citations).
General case: coherence descends along f (Descent on Spaces citation); suffices to show f^*(F cap f_*G) coherent.
Flatness: f^*(F cap f_*G) = f^*F cap f^*f_*G; flat-base-change gives f^*f_*G = p_*q^*G for p,q: Y x_X Y -> Y (citation).
p has a section (the diagonal), so the section case applies; coherence descends.
proof_roadmap: section case + descent reduction + flat identities; closes on the diagonal section.
difficulty_reason: Assembly: section case argued directly; general case reduces by descent (cited), flat-pullback intersection identity (one line), flat-base-change f^*f_*G = p_*q^*G (cited), and the section case applied to p which has the diagonal as a section.
